correctness.rationale: At uniform h=1/N, sine diagonalization yields exact λ=(kπ)^2, lumped λL=4N²sin²(kπ/2N), consistent λC=12N²sin²(kπ/2N)/(3−2sin²(kπ/2N)). For 1≤k≤⌊N/2⌋, independently checked exact polynomial identities for sine lower/upper Taylor barriers, g(y)=y(3−y)/(3−2y) monotonic, endpoint cubic negative on 0<z≤5/8, and H_z(yplus)>0. These analytically prove √(λLλC)<λ<(λL+λC)/2 for the entire stipulated domain. Sympy series verified upper error +(kπ)^6/(360N^4)−(kπ)^8/(6048N^6)+O(N^-8), lower error −(kπ)^6/(1440N^4)−(kπ)^8/(6048N^6)+O(N^-8), hence bracket width (kπ)^6/(288N^4)+O(N^-8), for fixed k. Finite checking is corroboration not proof.
